audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits a 50.0% win rate over 1020 games where the early lane is clearly his: Avengerang is 850 range on 9/8/7/6/5 and extends each time it clips something, against Aurora's 900 on 9/8.5/8/7.5/7. Aurora catches up from level 6 once Comeuppance can be body-blocked and her first item lands the rotation inside one shield window.

Spikes are grounded in real numbers: Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 needing terrain, Comeuppance 100/85/70 at 2500 range stopping on the first body, Going Rogue falling to a 2s cooldown and 0 mana at rank 5 with 5500 reach.

The two decisive interactions are both stated: Heroic Swing must anchor into terrain, so open ground denies it outright, and Comeuppance's stored bullets stop at the first champion, minion or structure. The Dirty Fighting shield flagged in missingInteractions is already handled in breakdown.carry, dontsFull[0].d, spikes[2].text and wants.you[1] — forcing it out before committing.
breakdown.cooldowns carries digits: Heroic Swing 18s rank 1, Avengerang 9s rank 1 to 5s rank 5, Comeuppance 100s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields were pure template: phases[5].why and phases[6].why say nothing about Akshan, and dosFull[2] promised roam advice under a body about a wasted Heroic Swing.
audit.why: 'Force trades on his cooldown gaps' and 'drop R on the objective clump and hop through the panic' would paste onto any enemy in the lane with no change. The Do's title/body mismatch is the copy-paste-bleed pattern.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten around Dirty Fighting's third-hit shield, Going Rogue's 5500-unit camouflage, and actual roam denial.
